Stories people stop for. Tools they keep.

Forefront is a design, illustration, animation and film studio in New Delhi. We make books, learning tools, hand-drawn films and brand stories for government programmes, development partners and brands that care how their work gets used, not just how it looks.

What we do

Design

Books, reports, guidebooks, toolkits and brand systems. Layouts built to be read, used and adapted, in print and on screen.

Illustration

Characters, scenes and visual systems drawn in-house, so a story looks like the place it was made for.

Animation

Hand-drawn, illustrative and animated films. Explainers, training films and brand stories that make a hard idea easy to follow, frame by frame.

Video production

Live-action films from script and shoot to edit and sound. Brand and corporate films, documentaries and stories from the field.

Content

Writing, editing and translation across Indian languages, so the words carry the same weight as the pictures.

We use AI for the slow, repetitive parts of production, like checks and first drafts. The drawing, the writing and the judgement stay with people.

What we believe

A handful of things we keep coming back to, whatever the project.

Pictures first, words second.

If a page only works for people who read comfortably, it only works for some people.

Design for the hand that holds it.

Size, paper and binding are design decisions. A tool that tears in the first monsoon gets thrown away.

Local, never generic.

People should see their own kitchen, their own clothes and their own language on the page.

Beautiful is not the goal. Used is.

We measure our work by whether someone reaches for it again, not by how it looks in a review meeting.

How a project moves

  1. 1

    Listen

    We start with the people who will use the work, not with the brief alone.

  2. 2

    Sketch

    Rough ideas and storyboards on paper, shared early and changed often.

  3. 3

    Test

    Drafts go in front of real readers before anything is locked.

  4. 4

    Make it travel

    One master, built to be adapted across languages, states and formats without losing its shape.
